summary: The LLM landscape in 2026 is dominated by a handful of frontier families—OpenAI's GPT line, Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini, Meta's Llama, and the fast-rising open-weight players DeepSeek, Mistral, and Qwen. Enterprise adoption is increasingly driven by multi-cloud aggregator availability (AWS Bedrock, Azure, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which amplifies real-world usage well beyond direct vendor APIs. Open-weight models have closed much of the quality gap while undercutting proprietary pricing dramatically, making cost-performance the defining competitive axis of the year.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Remains the most widely integrated model across developer tooling and is available via both the OpenAI API and Azure OpenAI, giving it enormous enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose multimodal applications and production chat assistants

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Released February 17, 2026 matching Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing, and is distributed through AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and direct API, driving heavy enterprise coding adoption.
models.best_for: Agentic coding workflows and enterprise software development

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: A context-window leader with deep integration across Google Vertex AI and Workspace, making it a default choice for enterprises already in the Google Cloud ecosystem.
models.best_for: Long-document analysis and large-context retrieval tasks

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: The high-volume, low-cost workhorse of the Gemini family with a 1M-token context, widely adopted for cost-sensitive production workloads through Vertex AI.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: A 671B-parameter MoE reasoning model that is the cheapest frontier-class model by a wide margin and sees massive HuggingFace download volume as an open-weight favorite.
models.best_for: Reasoning-heavy and mathematical tasks on a budget

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: The general-purpose open-weight counterpart to R1, delivering near-frontier quality at a fraction of proprietary pricing and widely self-hosted via HuggingFace.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: Meta's most-downloaded open-weight model on HuggingFace and available across AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI, giving it broad enterprise self-hosting and aggregator reach.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Released February 5, 2026 as Anthropic's top-tier reasoning model, used for the most demanding agentic and coding tasks and available via Bedrock and Vertex AI.
models.best_for: Complex agentic reasoning and high-stakes coding tasks

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: The leading European open-weight frontier model, available on Azure, Bedrock, and Vertex AI, with strong adoption among EU enterprises needing data-residency options.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Alibaba's flagship open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads and strong adoption in Asian markets and via self-hosting.
